author: Mark Atwood
text: Evidence from i72x.3 review (worker4, 2026-09-09): all 3 kimi-k3 review passes independently re-discovered the node.rs:196/526 fd00::/8 echo-reply branches while reviewing the hybrid.rs change and confirmed they are the same stale ULA-is-local semantics this migration removes (routing now says ULA=External; echo handler still says ULA=local). Security pass notes the contradiction is user-visible: ping to ULA still answered. Also confirmed: gateway.rs:1735 already drops upstream ULA (consistent); lichen-schc/src/headers.rs:143 is_ula in address profile is another site worth assessing under this sweep.
